mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the natural person who created the design and he may or may not be the statutory creator, where the latter is the one vested with the rights of the registered design.
The true creator is the natural person who created the design and he may or may not be the statutory creator, where the latter is the one vested with the rights of the registered design.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a name that is well-known in Japan and world-wide, as the name of a female singer from the United States.
The Court held that LADY GAGA is a name that is well-known in Japan and world-wide, as the name of a female singer from the United States.
Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the types of intellectual property rights.
Patent is one of the types of intellectual property rights.
Fill in the blank: ______ are the mark of the Standard Organisation of Nigeria (SON) indicating the quality of a product as certified by SON.
Examples of certification marks are the mark of the Standard Organisation of Nigeria (SON) indicating the quality of a product as certified by SON.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a trademark used to distinguish goods of a particular origin or common characteristics of different enterprises which use the sign under the control of an umbrella body.
A collective mark is a trademark used to distinguish goods of a particular origin or common characteristics of different enterprises which use the sign under the control of an umbrella body.
fib: ______ is a sale of a patent right.
Assignments An assignment is a sale of a patent right.
______ is an order of the court compelling a party to do or refrain from doing an act.
An injunction is an order of the court compelling a party to do or refrain from doing an act.
______ is a non-voluntary license granted by the court or government without the consent of the patentee in the interest of the public.
A compulsory license is a non-voluntary license granted by the court or government without the consent of the patentee in the interest of the public.
______ refer to compensation for losses that naturally flows from the act of the defendant and it need not be proved by the plaintiff as it is presumed by law.
General damages refer to compensation for losses that naturally flows from the act of the defendant and it need not be proved by the plaintiff as it is presumed by law.
______ are an essential drive for scientific and technological development of the society.
Patents are an essential drive for scientific and technological development of the society.
